22	OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath failed"
23	TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
24	for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the repository" ;; esac; done
25	if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT exists and is not an empty directory"; fi
26	TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
27	case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repository and OUT" ;; esac

30	cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"
31	
32	ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/stderr"
33	ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" -eq "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
34	g() { git --no-replace-objects -c core.quotepath=off -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false \

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope-r2.sh -- frozen by SPEC-r2 Part C. Existence and metadata only. Do not edit.
# Capture = the same local ref set as rank0-r2.sh. Read-only. No network. No host access. No `set -e`.
# Writes NO personal identities: no names, e-mails, user names, ref names, URLs, CODEOWNERS owners or path strings.
# Paths appear only as 16-hex SHA-256 ids; identities are compared inside a private temp dir; only counts are written.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/absolute/path/to/new/empty/dir bash scope-r2.sh
# Exit: 0 completed | 1 completed with unexpected exit codes or identity-guard failure | 2 refused to start | 3 capture invalid
set -u -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES
TAB=$'\t'
die() { printf 'scope-r2: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- P0 preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT is not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir 2>/dev/null)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the repository" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT exists and is not an empty directory"; fi
TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repository and OUT" ;; esac
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" || die 2 "cannot create OUT"
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/stderr"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" -eq "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
g() { git --no-replace-objects -c core.quotepath=off -c core.fsmonitor=false -c log.showSignature=false \
  -c log.mailmap=false -c log.decorate=false -c log.showRoot=true -c diff.renames=false -c color.ui=never "$@" 2>>"$TMP/stderr"; }
cnt() { awk 'END{print NR}' "$1"; }
iso() { if [ "$1" = - ]; then echo -; else date -u -d "@$1" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; fi; }
finish() {
  cnt "$TMP/stderr" > "$OUT/00_stderr_line_count.txt"
  ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"
  sha256sum < "$OUT/SHA256SUMS" | cut -d' ' -f1
  exit "$1"
}
SS="$(sha256sum < "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"; ok script.sha256 $? 0; printf '%s\n' "${SS%% *}" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
SPAN_LO_ISO=2026-08-02T00:00:00Z
SPAN_LO="$(date -u -d "$SPAN_LO_ISO" +%s)"; SPAN_HI="$(date -u -d 2026-08-16T00:00:00Z +%s)"

# ---- S0 environment and validity (same gate as rank-0) ----
SH="$(g rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)"; ok env.shallow $? 0
PC="$(g config --get extensions.partialClone)"; ok cfg.partialClone $? 0 1
PR="$(g config --get-regexp '^remote\..*\.(promisor|partialclonefilter)$')"; ok cfg.promisor $? 0 1
NPR="$(printf '%s' "$PR" | awk 'NF{c++} END{print c+0}')"
printf 'git_version\t%s\nis_shallow\t%s\npartial_clone\t%s\npromisor_or_filter_entries\t%s\n' "$(git --version)" "$SH" \
  "$([ -n "$PC" ] && echo set || echo unset)" "$NPR" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
if [ "$SH" != false ] || [ -n "$PC" ] || [ "$NPR" != 0 ]; then printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; fi

# ---- S1 capture (ref names stay in TMP; only a hash and counts are written) ----
g for-each-ref --format='%(objectname)%09%(objecttype)%09%(*objectname)%09%(*objecttype)%09%(refname)' > "$TMP/refs.raw"; ok refs $? 0
sort -t "$TAB" -k5,5 "$TMP/refs.raw" > "$TMP/refs.tsv"; ok refs.sort $? 0
RS="$(sha256sum < "$TMP/refs.tsv")"; ok refs.hash $? 0; printf '%s\n' "${RS%% *}" > "$OUT/50_capture_refs.sha256"   # equals SHA-256 of rank-0 01_refs.tsv
awk -F'\t' '$2=="commit"{print $1; next} $2=="tag" && $4=="commit"{print $3}' "$TMP/refs.tsv" | sort -u > "$TMP/tips"
awk -F'\t' '{c = ($5 ~ /^refs\/heads\//) ? "heads" : (($5 ~ /^refs\/remotes\//) ? "remotes" : (($5 ~ /^refs\/tags\//) ? "tags" : (($5 ~ /^refs\/notes\//) ? "notes" : "other"))); n[c]++}
  END{printf "heads\t%d\nremotes\t%d\ntags\t%d\nnotes\t%d\nother\t%d\n", n["heads"], n["remotes"], n["tags"], n["notes"], n["other"]}' "$TMP/refs.tsv" > "$OUT/50b_ref_counts.tsv"
if [ ! -s "$TMP/tips" ]; then printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; fi

# ---- S2 path universe over history (SC-3) ----
g log --stdin -m --no-renames --name-only --format= < "$TMP/tips" > "$TMP/pa.raw"; ok paths.history $? 0
awk 'NF' "$TMP/pa.raw" | sort -u > "$TMP/paths_all"
: > "$TMP/pt.raw"
while IFS= read -r t <&3; do g ls-tree -r --name-only --full-tree "$t" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/pt.raw"; ok "lstree.$t" $? 0; done 3< "$TMP/tips"
sort -u "$TMP/pt.raw" > "$TMP/paths_tips"
NA=$(cnt "$TMP/paths_all"); NT=$(comm -12 "$TMP/paths_all" "$TMP/paths_tips" | awk 'END{print NR}')
printf 'paths_ever\t%s\npaths_ever_and_at_some_tip\t%s\npaths_ever_not_at_any_tip\t%s\npaths_ever_under_dot_github\t%s\n' \
  "$NA" "$NT" "$((NA - NT))" "$(awk '/^[.]github\//' "$TMP/paths_all" | awk 'END{print NR}')" > "$OUT/51_path_universe.tsv"

# ---- S3 candidate channels (fixed vocabulary; whole tokens; SC-7) ----
AWK_CH=$(cat <<'EOF'
BEGIN { FS = "\t"
  split("register registers ruling rulings decision decisions", a, " "); for (i in a) REG[a[i]] = 1
  split("session sessions", a, " "); for (i in a) SESS[a[i]] = 1
  PROG["progress"] = 1
  split("status audit audits ledger ledgers adopt adopted adoption adoptions approval approvals signoff signoffs queue workplan workplans context norm norms inforce", a, " "); for (i in a) STAT[a[i]] = 1
  split("md markdown txt rst adoc org json yaml yml csv tsv toml log xml html", a, " "); for (i in a) DOCX[a[i]] = 1 }
{ p = $0; q = tolower(p); w = "/" q; b = q; sub(/.*\//, "", b)
  e = ""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/) { e = b; sub(/.*[.]/, "", e) }
  if (w ~ /^\/[.]github\/workflows\// || q == ".gitlab-ci.yml" || b == "jenkinsfile" || w ~ /^\/[.]circleci\// || q == "azure-pipelines.yml" || q == ".drone.yml" || q == "bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || w ~ /^\/[.]buildkite\// || q == ".woodpecker.yml" || w ~ /^\/[.]woodpecker\//) print "K-CI\t" p "\tci-path"
  if (w ~ /^\/[.]githooks\// || w ~ /^\/[.]husky\// || q == ".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b == "lefthook.yml" || b == ".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p "\thook-path"
  if (b == "codeowners") print "K-CFG\t" p "\tcodeowners"
  if (e != "" && !(e in DOCX)) next
  n = split(q, t, /[^a-z0-9]+/); r = ""; s = ""; gg = ""; x = ""
  for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) { k = t[i]; if (k == "") continue
    if (i < n && ((k == "in" && t[i+1] == "force") || (k == "sign" && t[i+1] == "off") || (k == "work" && t[i+1] == "plan"))) k = k t[i+1]
    if (r == "" && (k in REG)) r = k
    if (s == "" && (k in SESS)) s = k
    if (gg == "" && (k in PROG)) gg = k
    if (x == "" && (k in STAT)) x = k }
  if (r != "") print "K-REG\t" p "\t" r
  if (s != "") print "K-SESS\t" p "\t" s
  if (gg != "") print "K-PROG\t" p "\t" gg
  if (x != "") print "K-STATUS\t" p "\t" x }
EOF
)
awk "$AWK_CH" "$TMP/paths_all" | sort -u > "$TMP/cand.tsv"; ps=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}"); ok cand "${ps[0]}" 0

# ---- S4 per-path history metrics (ids only) ----
declare -A SIG
sigof() { if [ -z "${SIG[$1]:-}" ]; then g cat-file commit "$1" < /dev/null > "$TMP/obj"; ok "obj.$1" $? 0
  SIG[$1]="$(awk '/^$/{exit} /^gpgsig/{s=1} END{print (s ? "SIGNED" : "UNSIGNED")}' "$TMP/obj")"; fi; SIGR="${SIG[$1]}"; }
mkdir -p "$TMP/w" "$TMP/hc"; : > "$TMP/pm.tsv"; : > "$TMP/pid.tsv"
cut -f2 "$TMP/cand.tsv" | sort -u > "$TMP/cpaths"
while IFS= read -r p <&3; do
  id="$(printf '%s' "$p" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
  g log --stdin --no-merges --full-history --no-renames --name-status --format='::c::%x09%H%x09%ct%x09%ae%x09%ce' -- ":(literal)$p" < "$TMP/tips" > "$TMP/h"; ok "hist.$id" $? 0
  awk -F'\t' '$1=="::c::"{print $2 "\t" $3}' "$TMP/h" > "$TMP/hc/$id"
  awk -F'\t' '$1=="::c::"{print tolower($4); print tolower($5)}' "$TMP/h" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/w/$id"
  nc=$(cnt "$TMP/hc/$id")
  lo=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR==1{m=$2} $2<m{m=$2} END{print (NR ? m : "-")}' "$TMP/hc/$id")
  hi=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR==1{m=$2} $2>m{m=$2} END{print (NR ? m : "-")}' "$TMP/hc/$id")
  sp=$(awk -F'\t' -v a="$SPAN_LO" -v b="$SPAN_HI" '$2>=a && $2<b{c++} END{print c+0}' "$TMP/hc/$id")
  dl=$(awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^D/{c++} END{print (c ? 1 : 0)}' "$TMP/h")
  grep -Fxq -- "$p" "$TMP/paths_tips"; rc=$?; ok "attip.$id" "$rc" 0 1; tp=$((rc == 0 ? 1 : 0))
  ns=0; while IFS="$TAB" read -r c _ <&4; do sigof "$c"; if [ "$SIGR" = SIGNED ]; then ns=$((ns + 1)); fi; done 4< "$TMP/hc/$id"
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$nc" "$lo" "$hi" "$sp" "$dl" "$tp" "$ns" "$(cnt "$TMP/w/$id")" >> "$TMP/pm.tsv"
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$id" >> "$TMP/pid.tsv"
done 3< "$TMP/cpaths"

# ---- S5 writer sets (ACTOR_SET_ID; kept in TMP; only counts leave) ----
EXC=(':(exclude,glob,icase)**/*.md' ':(exclude,glob,icase)**/*.markdown' ':(exclude,glob,icase)**/*.txt' ':(exclude,glob,icase)**/*.rst'
     ':(exclude,glob,icase)**/*.adoc' ':(exclude,glob,icase)**/*.org')
for d in doc docs governance ruling rulings decision decisions adr adrs session sessions log logs notes plan plans planning minutes; do
  EXC+=(":(exclude,glob,icase)**/$d/**"); done
g log --stdin --no-merges --full-history --format='%ae%n%ce' -- . "${EXC[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" > "$TMP/we.raw"; ok writers.exec $? 0
tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < "$TMP/we.raw" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/w_exec"; ps=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}"); ok we.tr "${ps[0]}" 0

# Protocol B — minimal, neutral scoping of candidate norm-provenance channels

**Goal (from QUESTIONS.md):** decide, for a *bounded* list of locally checkable, read-only
channel types, whether any could be an **independent** record of *which norm was in force at
time t*. "Independent" = controlled by someone/something other than (a) the norm-maker,
(b) the executor of the work, (c) the ruling asserting its own effect. Existence/scoping only —
**no archaeology**, no evidence acquisition, **never a forced negative**.

The research programme's own artefacts (`docs/knowledgeos/**`) are **never** candidates
(self-contamination) and are excluded by the classifier.

## 1. Candidate channels (exact patterns)

| Id | What | Path pattern / source (case-insensitive) |
|----|------|-------------------------------------------|
| `K-CI` | CI definitions | `.github/workflows/**`, `.gitlab-ci.yml`, `Jenkinsfile`, `.circleci/**`, `azure-pipelines.yml`, `.drone.yml`, `bitbucket-pipelines.yml`, `.woodpecker*` |
| `K-HOOK` | repo-shipped git hooks | `.githooks/**`, `.husky/**`, `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, `lefthook.yml`, `.lefthook.yml` |
| `K-CODEOWNERS` | ownership / branch-protection hints in repo | path basename `CODEOWNERS` |
| `K-STATUS` | status register / rulings register / in-force record (**outside** `docs/knowledgeos/`) | doc-like ext (`md,markdown,txt,rst,json,ya?ml,toml,csv,tsv`) whose path matches a token in {`program_status,status,ruling(s),register,registry,decision(s),adoption,approval(s),signoff(s),progress,inforce,norm`}, e.g. `docs/implementation/PROGRAM_STATUS.md` |
| `K-DEPLOY` | deployment / config state | path token in {`deploy,deployment,release,environment,env,infra,terraform`} or ext `tfstate` |
| `K-SIG` | signed commits / tags | **presence** of `gpgsig` header / `-----BEGIN (PGP\|SSH) SIGNATURE-----`; keyring **not** consulted, signatures **not** verified |
| `K-LOCALHOOK` | local hooks (`LOCAL_ONLY`) | `.git/hooks/<standard-name>` present, or `core.hooksPath` set |

**Host-side channels — `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`** (host not authorized): `K-HOST-AUDIT`
(server audit logs), `K-HOST-BRANCHPROT` (branch-protection *enforcement*), `K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS`
(PR approvals), `K-CI-RUNS` (CI run history), `K-HOST-MEMBERS` (org/team membership).

## 2. Deterministic answer rules (every outcome reachable)

Scope = the **local ref set only**; completeness vs the host is never shown. `ND` =
`NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK`, `IND` = `INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE`. If a channel
has **0** located paths → every answer is `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)` (`NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE` /
`NOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY`). Host rows are `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` for all eight.

- **Q1 exists** → `YES_IN_CAPTURE` | `YES_LOCAL_ONLY` (`K-LOCALHOOK`) | `NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE` | `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`.
- **Q2 records** → by **type** only (`CONFIG_RULE`, `STATUS/NORM_RECORD`, `IDENTITY_ATTESTATION`); content not read → otherwise `ND`.
- **Q3 controls** → `CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=…]` (count only) | for `K-SIG` `ND(keyring not consulted)` | `LOCAL_MACHINE` (`K-LOCALHOOK`).
- **Q4 timestamps independent** → `NO_CLIENT_SET` (git recording times are client-generated; a self-attested timestamp is **not** independence). Content timestamps = `ND`.
- **Q5 norm-in-force at t** → `NO_BY_TYPE` for config/attestation channels (a rule/attestation is not a norm-state record); else `ND` — existence never decides this.
- **Q6 completeness** → `ND[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]` always (local ref set only).
- **Q7 independence** → see §3. Reachable: `IND[…]`, `NOT_INDEPENDENT[…]`, `NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT[self…]`, `NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)`.
- **Q8 reproducible** → `YES_LOCAL` (content-addressed, rerunnable on same ref set) | `NO_LOCAL_ONLY` (`K-LOCALHOOK`, unversioned) | `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY`.

## 3. Independence rule (count overlap only)

For each channel compute, over the local ref set, by **count only** (identities never leave a
private temp dir):

- **W** = the channel's own writer set (author+committer emails over its paths);
- **E** = *executor* writers = writers over all tracked paths **excluding every candidate
  channel path and `docs/knowledgeos/**`** — so **a channel's own writers are not executors by
  construction** (corrects the earlier defect);
- **N** = *norm-maker* writers = writers over the rulings/register subset of `K-STATUS`;
- `overlap_exec = |W ∩ E|`, `overlap_norm = |W ∩ N|`.

Mapping:
- Control mechanism **unobservable locally** (`K-CI`, `K-HOOK`, `K-CODEOWNERS` — enforcement is
  host/client-side; `K-SIG` — signatures unverified) → **`IND`** with the overlap counts attached.
- Mechanism observable (writer-set in repo) and `overlap_norm>0` → `NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT`
  for `K-STATUS` (self: it *is* the norm source) else `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm]`.
- Observable and `overlap_exec>0` → `NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec]` (an **observed** overlap, not a construction artefact).
- Observable and both overlaps `0` → **`IND`** `[writer_overlap=0; control_mechanism_unobservable]`
  (existence + zero overlap cannot *confirm* a positive).

A `NOT_INDEPENDENT` verdict therefore arises only from genuinely observed cross-role authorship;
where overlap is unknown or the mechanism unobservable the verdict is `IND` — **never a forced negative.**

## 4. Completeness rule

**Checkable locally:** existence of the paths/hooks above in the local ref set; per-channel
commit-count, writer-**count**, and signature **presence**; writer-overlap counts. **Not
checkable locally (declared):** branch-protection enforcement, PR approvals, server audit logs,
CI run history, org membership, host push times, and whether the local ref set is complete vs
the host. All of these are reported as `NOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY` / `COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN`;
content of any file (what a rule or record *says*) is `ND` because content is not read.

## 5. Output (written by `scope_b.sh` into an empty `$OUT` outside the repo)

- `60_channel_metrics.tsv` — per channel: `channel, paths, commits, writers, overlap_exec, overlap_norm` (counts only).
- `61_path_ids.tsv` — `16-hex-id → channel` (no path strings leave the repo).
- `58_signatures.tsv` — `commits_total, commits_signed, tags_signed`.
- `56_local_hooks.tsv` — `standard_hooks_present, core_hooksPath`.
- `70_answers.tsv` — candidate × Q1..Q8 (the §2/§3 mapping), incl. `K-SIG`, `K-LOCALHOOK`, host rows.
- `71_overall.tsv` — headline `NIF_A_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK`,
  `complete_vs_host=NOT_SHOWN`, open/excluded counts, host-channel count, `identity_guard`.
- `00_script.sha256`, `00_env.tsv`, `00_errors.tsv`, and `SHA256SUMS` over every emitted file.

**Guarantees:** read-only; `LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC` + config isolation (deterministic); no `set -e`
(explicit exits 0/1/2/3); own absolute path resolved+hashed **before** the one `cd`; refuses any
`$OUT` inside the work tree or `.git`; emits **counts only** — no names, emails, ref names, URLs,
owners or path strings; a final `identity_guard` greps `$OUT` for `@`/signature markers and fails
closed (exit 1). The **only** content read beyond existence/size/counts is commit/tag object
headers for **signature presence** (Q1/Q2/Q7 for `K-SIG` strictly require it); no file blob is read.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scope_b.sh -- Protocol B scoping. Read-only; existence/metadata only. No network, no host access.
# Emits COUNTS ONLY: no names, emails, ref names, URLs or path strings leave TMP; paths -> 16-hex ids.
# The ONLY content read beyond existence/counts is commit/tag object headers for signature PRESENCE
# (Q1/Q2/Q7 for K-SIG strictly require it); no file blob is ever read.
# Usage (from anywhere inside the working clone):  OUT=/abs/empty/dir bash scope_b.sh
# Exit: 0 ok | 1 ok-with-unexpected-codes or identity-guard fail | 2 refused | 3 capture invalid
set -u -o pipefail
export LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null \
  GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH=1 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_NAMESPACE
die() { printf 'scope_b: %s\n' "$2" >&2; exit "$1"; }

# ---- resolve OWN absolute path and hash it BEFORE any cd (corrects earlier relative-BASH_SOURCE defect) ----
SELF="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; case "$SELF" in /*) ;; *) SELF="$PWD/$SELF" ;; esac
SELF="$(realpath -- "$SELF")" || die 2 "cannot resolve own path"
SELFSHA="$(sha256sum < "$SELF" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || die 2 "cannot hash self"

git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.showsignature=false -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath OUT failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT must be an empty directory"; fi
TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repo and OUT" ;; esac
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" || die 2 "cannot create OUT"
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"   # the one and only cd; self already resolved+hashed above

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/e"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" = "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$SELFSHA" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
printf 'git_version\t%s\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
ND=NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK; IND=INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
finish() { ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"; exit "$1"; }

# ---- classify candidate channels (bounded vocabulary; docs/knowledgeos excluded) ----
awk -F'\t' '
{ p=$0; q=tolower(p); b=q; sub(/.*\//,"",b)
  if (q ~ /^docs\/knowledgeos\//) next
  if (q ~ /^[.]github\/workflows\// || q==".gitlab-ci.yml" || b=="jenkinsfile" || q ~ /^[.]circleci\// || q=="azure-pipelines.yml" || q==".drone.yml" || q=="bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || q ~ /^[.]woodpecker/) print "K-CI\t" p
  if (q ~ /^[.]githooks\// || q ~ /^[.]husky\// || q==".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b=="lefthook.yml" || b==".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p
  if (b=="codeowners") print "K-CODEOWNERS\t" p
  e=""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/){e=b; sub(/.*[.]/,"",e)}
  docx=(e=="md"||e=="markdown"||e=="txt"||e=="rst"||e=="json"||e=="yaml"||e=="yml"||e=="toml"||e=="csv"||e=="tsv")
  if (docx && q ~ /(^|\/)(program_status|status|rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|adoptions?|approvals?|signoffs?|progress|inforce|norm)([._/-]|$)/) print "K-STATUS\t" p
  if (q ~ /(^|\/)(deploy|deployment|release|environment|env|infra|terraform)([._/-]|$)/ || e=="tfstate") print "K-DEPLOY\t" p }' \

ok writers.exec "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
: > "$TMP/N"
awk -F'\t' '$1=="K-STATUS" && tolower($2) ~ /(^|\/)(rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|norm|inforce|authoriz)/ {print $2}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/npaths"
if [ -s "$TMP/npaths" ]; then mapfile -t NP < "$TMP/npaths"
  git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- "${NP[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/N"
  ok writers.norm "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
fi

# ---- per-channel metrics (counts only) + path-id map (no path strings) ----
: > "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"; : > "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
for ch in K-CI K-HOOK K-CODEOWNERS K-STATUS K-DEPLOY; do
  awk -F'\t' -v c="$ch" '$1==c{print $2}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/cp"
  np=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/cp"); : > "$TMP/W"; nc=0
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    id="$(printf '%s' "$p" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$ch" >> "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"
    git log --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- ":(literal)$p" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/W" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok "w.$id" $? 0
    k=$(git log --no-merges --format='%H' -- ":(literal)$p" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk 'END{print NR}'); nc=$((nc+k))
  done < "$TMP/cp"
  tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < "$TMP/W" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Wu"
  nw=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Wu")
  oe=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/E" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  on=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/N" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$ch" "$np" "$nc" "$nw" "$oe" "$on" >> "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
done

# ---- K-SIG: signature PRESENCE only (justified object-header read; keyring not consulted) ----
git rev-list --stdin < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | sort -u > "$TMP/allc"; ok revlist "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
nS=0
while IFS= read -r c; do
  git cat-file commit "$c" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk '/^$/{exit} /^gpgsig/{s=1} END{exit (s?0:1)}' && nS=$((nS+1))
done < "$TMP/allc"
nTS=0
while IFS= read -r line; do set -- $line; [ "${2:-}" = tag ] || continue
  git cat-file tag "$1" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | grep -qE '^-----BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE-----$' && nTS=$((nTS+1))

git() { command git -c core.quotepath=off -c log.showsignature=false -c log.mailmap=false -c color.ui=never "$@"; }

# ---- preconditions (exit 2) ----
OUT="${OUT:-}"; [ -n "$OUT" ] || die 2 "OUT not set"
case "$OUT" in /*) ;; *) die 2 "OUT must be an absolute path" ;; esac
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die 2 "not inside a work tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse --is-bare-repository 2>/dev/null)" = false ] || die 2 "bare repository"
TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || die 2 "no toplevel"
GD="$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)" || die 2 "no git dir"
OUT="$(realpath -m -- "$OUT")" || die 2 "realpath OUT failed"
TOPR="$(realpath -- "$TOP")"; GDR="$(realpath -- "$GD")"
for d in "$TOPR" "$GDR"; do case "$OUT/" in "$d"/*) die 2 "OUT must be outside the work tree and .git" ;; esac; done
if [ -e "$OUT" ]; then { [ -d "$OUT" ] && [ -z "$(ls -A -- "$OUT")" ]; } || die 2 "OUT must be an empty directory"; fi
TMP="$(mktemp -d)" || die 2 "mktemp failed"; TMP="$(realpath -- "$TMP")"
case "$TMP/" in "$TOPR"/*|"$GDR"/*|"$OUT"/*) rm -rf -- "$TMP"; die 2 "TMPDIR must be outside the repo and OUT" ;; esac
trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT
mkdir -p -- "$OUT" || die 2 "cannot create OUT"
cd -- "$TOP" || die 2 "cannot cd to the toplevel"   # the one and only cd; self already resolved+hashed above

ERR="$OUT/00_errors.tsv"; : > "$ERR"; : > "$TMP/e"
ok() { local l="$1" rc="$2" a; shift 2; for a in "$@"; do [ "$rc" = "$a" ] && return 0; done; printf '%s\t%s\n' "$l" "$rc" >> "$ERR"; return 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$SELFSHA" > "$OUT/00_script.sha256"
printf 'git_version\t%s\n' "$(git --version)" > "$OUT/00_env.tsv"
ND=NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK; IND=INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE
finish() { ( cd -- "$OUT" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS -print | sort | xargs -r -d '\n' sha256sum ) > "$OUT/SHA256SUMS"; exit "$1"; }

# ---- capture validity + local ref set -> tracked path universe (existence/scoping only) ----
SH="$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository 2>/dev/null)"; ok env.shallow $? 0
PC="$(git config --get extensions.partialClone)"; ok cfg.partialClone $? 0 1
if [ "$SH" != false ] || [ -n "$PC" ]; then printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; fi
git for-each-ref --format='%(objectname) %(objecttype) %(*objectname)' > "$TMP/refs" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok refs $? 0
awk '$2=="commit"{print $1} $2=="tag" && $3!=""{print $3}' "$TMP/refs" | sort -u > "$TMP/tips"
[ -s "$TMP/tips" ] || { printf 'overall\tCAPTURE_INVALID\n' > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; finish 3; }
: > "$TMP/paths"
while IFS= read -r t; do git ls-tree -r --name-only --full-tree "$t" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/paths" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok lstree $? 0; done < "$TMP/tips"
sort -u "$TMP/paths" > "$TMP/pu"; mv "$TMP/pu" "$TMP/paths"

# ---- classify candidate channels (bounded vocabulary; docs/knowledgeos excluded) ----
awk -F'\t' '
{ p=$0; q=tolower(p); b=q; sub(/.*\//,"",b)
  if (q ~ /^docs\/knowledgeos\//) next
  if (q ~ /^[.]github\/workflows\// || q==".gitlab-ci.yml" || b=="jenkinsfile" || q ~ /^[.]circleci\// || q=="azure-pipelines.yml" || q==".drone.yml" || q=="bitbucket-pipelines.yml" || q ~ /^[.]woodpecker/) print "K-CI\t" p
  if (q ~ /^[.]githooks\// || q ~ /^[.]husky\// || q==".pre-commit-config.yaml" || b=="lefthook.yml" || b==".lefthook.yml") print "K-HOOK\t" p
  if (b=="codeowners") print "K-CODEOWNERS\t" p
  e=""; if (b ~ /[.][^.]+$/){e=b; sub(/.*[.]/,"",e)}
  docx=(e=="md"||e=="markdown"||e=="txt"||e=="rst"||e=="json"||e=="yaml"||e=="yml"||e=="toml"||e=="csv"||e=="tsv")
  if (docx && q ~ /(^|\/)(program_status|status|rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|adoptions?|approvals?|signoffs?|progress|inforce|norm)([._/-]|$)/) print "K-STATUS\t" p
  if (q ~ /(^|\/)(deploy|deployment|release|environment|env|infra|terraform)([._/-]|$)/ || e=="tfstate") print "K-DEPLOY\t" p }' \
  "$TMP/paths" | sort -u > "$TMP/cand"

# ---- writer sets (identities stay in TMP; only counts/overlaps leave). E excludes every candidate ----
# channel path + docs/knowledgeos, so a channel's own writers are NOT executors by construction.
cut -f2 "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/candpaths"
EXC=( ':(exclude,glob,icase)docs/knowledgeos/**' )
while IFS= read -r p; do [ -n "$p" ] && EXC+=( ":(exclude,literal)$p" ); done < "$TMP/candpaths"
git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- . "${EXC[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/E"
ok writers.exec "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
: > "$TMP/N"
awk -F'\t' '$1=="K-STATUS" && tolower($2) ~ /(^|\/)(rulings?|register|registry|decisions?|norm|inforce|authoriz)/ {print $2}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/npaths"
if [ -s "$TMP/npaths" ]; then mapfile -t NP < "$TMP/npaths"
  git log --stdin --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- "${NP[@]}" < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/N"
  ok writers.norm "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
fi

# ---- per-channel metrics (counts only) + path-id map (no path strings) ----
: > "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"; : > "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
for ch in K-CI K-HOOK K-CODEOWNERS K-STATUS K-DEPLOY; do
  awk -F'\t' -v c="$ch" '$1==c{print $2}' "$TMP/cand" | sort -u > "$TMP/cp"
  np=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/cp"); : > "$TMP/W"; nc=0
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    id="$(printf '%s' "$p" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$id" "$ch" >> "$OUT/61_path_ids.tsv"
    git log --no-merges --format='%ae%n%ce' -- ":(literal)$p" < /dev/null >> "$TMP/W" 2>>"$TMP/e"; ok "w.$id" $? 0
    k=$(git log --no-merges --format='%H' -- ":(literal)$p" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk 'END{print NR}'); nc=$((nc+k))
  done < "$TMP/cp"
  tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' < "$TMP/W" | awk 'NF' | sort -u > "$TMP/Wu"
  nw=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/Wu")
  oe=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/E" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  on=$(comm -12 "$TMP/Wu" "$TMP/N" | awk 'END{print NR}')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$ch" "$np" "$nc" "$nw" "$oe" "$on" >> "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
done

# ---- K-SIG: signature PRESENCE only (justified object-header read; keyring not consulted) ----
git rev-list --stdin < "$TMP/tips" 2>>"$TMP/e" | sort -u > "$TMP/allc"; ok revlist "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" 0
nS=0
while IFS= read -r c; do
  git cat-file commit "$c" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | awk '/^$/{exit} /^gpgsig/{s=1} END{exit (s?0:1)}' && nS=$((nS+1))
done < "$TMP/allc"
nTS=0
while IFS= read -r line; do set -- $line; [ "${2:-}" = tag ] || continue
  git cat-file tag "$1" < /dev/null 2>>"$TMP/e" | grep -qE '^-----BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE-----$' && nTS=$((nTS+1))
done < "$TMP/refs"
printf 'commits_total\t%s\ncommits_signed\t%s\ntags_signed\t%s\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/allc")" "$nS" "$nTS" > "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv"

# ---- K-LOCALHOOK: local .git/hooks presence (LOCAL_ONLY, unversioned) ----
HOOKS="applypatch-msg commit-msg post-checkout post-commit post-merge post-receive post-update pre-applypatch pre-commit pre-merge-commit pre-push pre-rebase pre-receive prepare-commit-msg update"
nh=0; for hk in $HOOKS; do [ -e "$GD/hooks/$hk" ] && nh=$((nh+1)); done
hp=unset; git config --get core.hooksPath > /dev/null 2>&1 && hp=set
printf 'standard_hooks_present\t%s\ncore_hooksPath\t%s\n' "$nh" "$hp" > "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv"

# ---- answers Q1..Q8 (deterministic; every outcome reachable; never a forced negative) ----
{
printf '#channel\tQ1_exists\tQ2_records\tQ3_controls\tQ4_ts_independent\tQ5_norm_at_t\tQ6_complete\tQ7_independent\tQ8_reproducible\n'
awk -F'\t' -v ND="$ND" -v IND="$IND" 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"}
{ ch=$1; np=$2+0; nw=$4+0; oe=$5+0; on=$6+0
  if (np==0){ print ch,"NOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)","NOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)"; next }
  cfg=(ch=="K-CI"||ch=="K-HOOK"||ch=="K-CODEOWNERS"||ch=="K-DEPLOY")
  q2=cfg?"CONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)":(ch=="K-STATUS"?"STATUS/NORM_RECORD(by type; content not read)":ND)
  q5=cfg?"NO_BY_TYPE(configuration rule, not a norm-state record)":ND
  if (ch=="K-CI"||ch=="K-HOOK"||ch=="K-CODEOWNERS") q7=IND"[mechanism_host_enforced_unobservable;overlap_exec=" oe ";overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (ch=="K-STATUS" && on>0) q7="NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT[self;overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (on>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_norm=" on "]"
  else if (oe>0) q7="NOT_INDEPENDENT[overlap_exec=" oe "]"
  else q7=IND"[writer_overlap=0;control_mechanism_unobservable]"
  print ch,"YES_IN_CAPTURE",q2,"CONTROLLED_BY_WRITERS[n=" nw "]","NO_CLIENT_SET(git recording times are client-generated)",q5,ND "[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]",q7,"YES_LOCAL(content-addressed; rerunnable on same ref set)" }' \
  "$OUT/60_channel_metrics.tsv"
read -r nC nSg nTg < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["commits_total"]+0, v["commits_signed"]+0, v["tags_signed"]+0}' "$OUT/58_signatures.tsv")
if [ "$nSg" -gt 0 ] || [ "$nTg" -gt 0 ]; then
  printf 'K-SIG\tYES_IN_CAPTURE\tIDENTITY_ATTESTATION(presence only; not verified)\t%s(keyring not consulted)\tNO_CLIENT_SET(signer clock)\tNO_BY_TYPE(attestation, not a norm-state record)\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(signatures not verified)\tYES_LOCAL(presence only)\n' "$ND" "$ND" "$IND"
else
  printf 'K-SIG\tNOT_EVIDENCED_IN_CAPTURE\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\n'
fi
read -r hn hpv < <(awk -F'\t' '{v[$1]=$2} END{print v["standard_hooks_present"]+0, v["core_hooksPath"]}' "$OUT/56_local_hooks.tsv")
if [ "$hn" -gt 0 ] || [ "$hpv" = set ]; then
  printf 'K-LOCALHOOK\tYES_LOCAL_ONLY\tCONFIG_RULE(by type; content not read)\tLOCAL_MACHINE\tNONE\tNO_BY_TYPE\t%s[COMPLETE_VS_HOST=NOT_SHOWN]\t%s(local, unversioned)\tNO_LOCAL_ONLY(not versioned; not reproducible from the ref set)\n' "$ND" "$IND"
else
  printf 'K-LOCALHOOK\tNOT_EVIDENCED_LOCALLY\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\tNOT_APPLICABLE(Q1)\n'
fi
for hc in K-HOST-AUDIT K-HOST-BRANCHPROT K-HOST-PR-APPROVALS K-CI-RUNS K-HOST-MEMBERS; do
  printf '%s\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\tNOT_CHECKABLE_LOCALLY\n' "$hc"
done
} > "$OUT/70_answers.tsv"

# ---- overall (never a forced negative) + fail-closed identity guard ----
{
printf 'headline\tNIF_A_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE_BY_EXISTENCE_CHECK\n'
printf 'complete_vs_host\tNOT_SHOWN\n'
printf 'open_local_candidates\t%s\n' "$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $8 ~ /^INDEPENDENCE_NOT_DETERMINABLE/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")"
printf 'not_independent_by_overlap\t%s\n' "$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $8 ~ /^(NOT_INDEPENDENT|NORM_SOURCE_NOT_INDEPENDENT)/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")"
printf 'not_evidenced\t%s\n' "$(awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && $2 ~ /^NOT_EVIDENCED/{c++} END{print c+0}' "$OUT/70_answers.tsv")"
printf 'host_channels\t5\n'
} > "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
code=0; [ -s "$ERR" ] && code=1
if grep -rlE '@|BEGIN (PGP|SSH) SIGNATURE' -- "$OUT" > "$TMP/hit" 2>/dev/null; then
  printf 'identity_guard\tFAIL(%s files)\n' "$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$TMP/hit")" >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"; code=1
else
  printf 'identity_guard\tPASS\n' >> "$OUT/71_overall.tsv"
fi
finish "$code"
